title: Surface Plane
rationale: PF-WP-020 produces static RoutePlans. R1 needs a dynamic layer: which step in the plan a user actually attaches to (a seat, a window, an audio sink), how that binding is leased, and what happens when the binding fails. This is the R1 surface layer.
acceptance_signals: RouteBinding references a real RouteStep.node by id
SurfaceLease has 3 states (Pending, Active, Revoked) with explicit transitions
fabric::check_admit for surface uses the same Decision/ReasonCode contract as PF-WP-011
